title: Bloom on active notes: the cost of each pass
question: Making the chord's markers glow with RenderPipeline's bloom, what does each configuration add: bloom on the whole scene, selective bloom from an emissive MRT output, and bloom at half resolution?
hypothesis: Bloom adds a fixed chain of blur passes whose cost follows the resolution, not the scene; selective bloom adds a second color attachment to the scene pass.

predictions.predicted: about 10 to 12 (5 mip levels, down and up, plus composite)

predictions.metric: median GPU ms added by bloom at 1920x1080
bloom at half resolution against full
predictions.predicted: at most 0.6x the added GPU ms
